transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well… I guess it’s my eating, mostly. It’s probably not that big a thing, but I’m hardly eating right lately. Some days it’s just coffee and maybe a piece of bread, and my pants are getting loose on me… hanging off more than they used to. I thought I should maybe get it checked, if that’s okay.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight recently?

Yeah… I think so. I haven’t really weighed myself, but I can tell because my pants are getting pretty loose, kind of hanging off me. I’m just not eating much lately—some days it’s only coffee and maybe a piece of bread. I don’t mean to make it sound dramatic, but it does seem like I’ve lost some.
Are you trying to lose weight?

No, not really… I’m not trying to lose weight. I just don’t seem to eat right anymore. Like I said, some days it’s only coffee and maybe a piece of bread, and then I notice my pants are kind of hanging loose. I don’t mean to make a big deal of it, but that’s what’s been happening.
Do you feel less hungry than you used to?

Yeah… I think I do. I don’t get hungry like I used to, or I just kind of ignore it, I guess. Some days I only end up having coffee and maybe a piece of bread. It’s probably not good, but… that’s been happening.
Are you happy about the weight loss you've experienced?

No… I wouldn’t say I’m happy about it. I mean, maybe it sounds nice to have looser pants, but it doesn’t feel like a good thing. It’s more like… I just haven’t been eating right, some days just coffee and maybe a piece of bread, and then I notice my pants hanging loose. I know that’s not great.
Do you find that food doesn't taste as good as it used to?

Yeah… I guess maybe it doesn’t taste the same, or I just don’t really care about eating much. I don’t want to make it sound worse than it is, but I hardly eat right anymore—some days it’s just coffee and maybe a piece of bread. Then I notice my pants are hanging loose on me. Is that the kind of thing you mean?
Are you trying to lose weight by not eating enough?

No, I’m not trying to lose weight on purpose. It’s not like a diet or anything… I just hardly eat right anymore. Some days I’ll only have coffee and maybe a piece of bread, and then I notice my pants are hanging loose. I know that doesn’t sound good.
Do you feel anxious or upset when you think about eating?
I don’t think so… not really anxious, like scared of eating. It’s more like I just don’t feel like bothering with it sometimes. I hope that makes sense.
Do you think your lack of interest in eating is related to how you've been feeling emotionally?

Yeah… I think it probably is. I mean, I’m not doing it to myself on purpose or anything. It’s just when I’m feeling like this, food kind of drops off my mind. I end up hardly eating right—coffee, maybe some bread—and then I notice my pants are loose. I guess that’s why I’m here, really.
Do you think there's something specific that's been bothering you emotionally that's causing you to lose interest in eating?

I guess… yeah, maybe not one specific thing, exactly. It’s more like most days I wake up with this heavy, empty feeling in my chest, like there’s nothing good waiting for me. I know that sounds kind of dramatic, sorry… but I just want to keep my head down, and then eating doesn’t really feel important.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?

No… I don’t think so. I mean, I’m not trying to lose weight or anything like that. Gaining weight isn’t really what I’m worried about. It’s more just… I don’t feel much interest in food, if that makes sense.
Do you ever worry about what you look like when you think about eating or gaining weight?

No, not really… I don’t think I’m worrying about how I look. I mean, I guess nobody wants to look bad, but that’s not what’s going through my head when I eat or don’t eat. It’s more like I just don’t think about food much. Does that make sense?
Do you feel like you're avoiding eating because of the act of eating itself, or is it just that food doesn't seem interesting or important to you right now?

It’s not really the act of eating, I don’t think. I’m not scared of chewing or swallowing or anything like that. It’s more like food just doesn’t feel worth bothering with right now.

I mean… I guess I’m not eating right. Some days it’s just coffee and maybe a piece of bread, and then I tell myself that’s enough. My pants are getting loose, so I know it’s probably not nothing… but I’m not trying to do that. It just doesn’t seem important, if that makes sense.
Do you think you would be upset if you started gaining weight again?

I don’t think I’d be upset, no. I mean… if I gained a little back, that’d probably be okay, because my pants are kind of hanging loose on me now.

It’s not that I’m trying to keep weight off or anything. I just hardly eat right lately—some days it’s coffee and maybe a piece of bread, and I know that probably doesn’t sound great.
Do you feel like you get any pleasure from eating when you do eat?

Not much, honestly. I mean, if I do eat, it’s not like I hate it or anything… it just doesn’t really do anything for me right now.

I know I’ve said it already, but what brought me in is I hardly eat right anymore—some days it’s just coffee and maybe a piece of bread, and my pants are hanging loose. I’m not trying to make it sound worse than it is, but… yeah, I guess eating doesn’t feel very pleasurable or important lately.
When you do eat, is it because you feel like you need to, rather than because you want to?

Yeah… I think that’s right. When I do eat, it’s more because I know I probably should, not because I really want to.

I don’t mean to make it sound dramatic, but that’s kind of what brought me in—I’m hardly eating right anymore. Some days it’s just coffee and maybe a piece of bread, and then I sort of tell myself that’s enough. My pants are hanging loose on me now, so… I guess it’s gotten noticeable.
Do you think you would eat more if you didn't think it would lead to gaining weight?

I don’t think the weight gain part is really what stops me, doctor. I mean… I’m not sitting there worried that if I eat I’ll gain weight.

It’s more like I just don’t feel like eating much at all. Some days I end up just having coffee and maybe a piece of bread, and then I let it go. My pants are hanging loose now, so I know it’s probably more than I should brush off.
Do you ever feel like if you start eating, you won't be able to stop?

No, not really. I don’t think it’s that I’m afraid I’ll lose control or keep eating once I start.

It’s more the opposite, I guess… I just don’t get around to eating much, or I don’t feel like it. Like I said, some days it’s just coffee and maybe a piece of bread, and then I kind of tell myself that’s okay. My pants are getting loose, so I know it’s probably not great… if that makes sense.
Do you feel like eating is something you're avoiding, or is it just not something you enjoy doing anymore?

I think it’s more that I don’t enjoy it, or… I don’t have much want for it anymore. I’m not exactly trying to avoid eating on purpose.

It’s just, like I said, I hardly eat right lately. Some days I’ll have coffee and maybe a piece of bread, and then I kind of let that be it. I know that probably doesn’t sound good. My pants are hanging loose on me now, so I guess it’s gotten more noticeable than I wanted to admit.
Do you think there's a connection between your mood and your lack of interest in food?

Yeah… I think there probably is, at least some connection. When I’m feeling worse, food just doesn’t really appeal to me. It’s not that I’m trying to make a big thing out of it, but I hardly eat right anymore.

Some days it’s honestly just coffee and maybe a piece of bread, and then I kind of leave it at that. My pants are hanging loose on me now, so… I guess it’s enough that I shouldn’t keep pretending it’s nothing. Does that make sense?
